app.name: Med Connect
app.tagline: A professional home for urologists in Israel
app.description: A professional platform for physicians, starting with urologists in Israel: news, events, education, chat, and a section for each organisation they belong to.

demo.banner: Demo version: all people and data shown are fictional.
demo.disclaimer: Med Connect is an independent platform presented as a proposal. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by any professional association or medical organisation.

home.heroTitle: A professional home for urologists in Israel
home.heroBody: One place for news, conferences and events, educational content and your organisations, in Hebrew and English.

events.title: Events & conferences
events.body: Event calendar, registration and a personal schedule.

education.title: Education
education.body: Lectures, articles and presentations by subspecialty and level.

guidelines.title: Guidelines
guidelines.body: Links to the current official guidelines.

membership.title: Organisations
membership.body: Registration, verification by your department director, and a digital membership card.
